description: Owner salary normalization ported from ApexLogics Apex #158 (AL-172). From an owner's total compensation package (W-2 salary, distributions, health insurance, retirement, personal expenses run through the company) and a replacement manager's fully loaded cost (market wage, benefits load, employer payroll taxes), the node computes Seller Discretionary Earnings (net income + owner package + one-time expenses) and Normalized EBITDA (the same, less the replacement cost), plus the normalization adjustment, its valuation impact at the caller's SDE multiple, the owner's effective hourly rate with a suppression flag, the owner package as a percent of replacement cost in basis points, and a neutral reasonable-compensation pattern flag (W-2 below 60% of replacement cost with distributions exceeding W-2). Employer payroll taxes left at zero are computed from the 2026 OASDI wage base ($184,500) at the IRC 3111 employer rates (6.2% Social Security capped at the base, 1.45% Medicare uncapped). Deterministic, zero external data, reads no clock; every input is optional and falls back to the live page's shipped defaults, so the kernel has no refusal branch. Deliberate fidelity limits carried from the source page: whole-dollar rounding on inputs and the payroll-tax legs (DIFFERS-2), the wage base applied as min(annual owner W-2, base) with no year-to-date threading (DIFFERS-1), employer share only (the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax is an employee withholding with no employer match and is out of scope), federal only, one year only, one replacement manager.
